rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card and predictions before data, calibration and synthetic (9 scenarios, 40 replicates, plus P4 power), Amendment 1 before real data, 25 transitions x 7 input variants, 3 natives (NE38, G44, G26), per-period estimates, confirm.py frozen and dry-run, not run.
rationale.faithfulness: The scoped claim (a kickoff erases position beyond an ordinary day) beats a calibrated kickoff-matched placebo in 16/18 kickoffs and every variant (C = 2). The HH-literal law fails: anisotropic, overshooting, no shown agent constancy (D = 1). Scorecard A1 B1 C2 D1 E1 F2 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: Corrects how to read day-1 content (overshoot, scrambling beyond the goal axis) and gives one clean lever observation (a one-agent goal change retargets only that agent). The hoped-for per-agent steerability rank is not available. The embedding-memory artifact is a useful instrument note.

one_line: A goal kickoff is a restoring force: cross-agent memory falls 0.68 -> 0.42 (drho +0.26 +/- 0.04, 16/18 kickoffs, both models), stiffer along the goal and overshooting on day 1; the per-agent rate is not shown to be an agent constant.
